release_notes:
LockStepPDF 4.0.23

This hot-fix replaces the installed program file. The zip contains LockStepPDF.exe and the matching _internal folder. The updater copies that program onto the file name already installed, including ReadySetPDF.exe. It does not remove folders already next to the program, so the LibreOffice folder from 4.0.15 stays and Office files still convert. This zip does not include LibreOffice.

Grid imposition can show bleed that is already in the PDF. Under PDF already includes bleed, Bleed to show sets how much of that existing ring stays around the trim. A blank amount behaves as before. A positive amount keeps that ring, and the gutter is extra white between the rings. A negative gutter overlaps the rings before the trims meet.

The monitor has an F5 button, and the F5 key does the same thing when a text field does not have focus. It redraws the monitor from the asset list and the settings on screen, and it clears a preview that got stuck. It does not change the files, the page, or the form.
